facts.fact: CORRECTS F940 (flag for S7): at the ch24 namings the scorching witness entries were on each member's own handed-back Resin House page, which Neela held on her knee beside Chathu's sheaf. Chathu's forty leaves are plain ink and only curled in the heat; they never burned. Neela realises this in ch29.

Chathu's tins of sweets: eleven before her eleven killings, one in the kennels, one on the Resin House gatepost, and one carried out of his cell (the warm tin in ch29 arrives by palace post). Corrects any 'twelve before a killing' count.

Neela cites Sanu's Pallikara as a crown-leaf intake village burned this season (not Thulasi's Pazhayangadi, which belongs to the forty); every village on the thirty rolls was raided the year its child was taken.
